thread:
alex (PM): FYI — ACME asked if we can ship a "Compute Isolation" add-on for Dedicated/Private. They want guaranteed GPU pools per-tenant + billing as an add-on. Can we decide scope and launch criteria this week?

maya (Eng): What exactly do they mean by "guaranteed GPU pools"? full tenant v-silo or soft isolation (reserved slots)?

sam (Sales): They explicitly asked for tenant-level pools isolated from other customers for compliance reviews. Will pay a premium if SLA and audit logs included.

alex (PM): Sam says compliance + audit logs is a must. Proposal: two SKUs — "Isolation Basic" (reserved vGPU share, no extra SLA) and "Isolation Premium" (dedicated pool, 99.95% uptime SLA, audit logs, KMS integration). Thoughts?

maya (Eng): From infra POV: Basic = reservation via quota + scheduling pinning (low effort). Premium = separate node pools + tenant routing + perf/cost isolation (significant). Need spike + capacity math.

nora (Solutions): Also need clear UX in Console: per-route toggle, cost preview, and migration path. Customers expect fast failback to shared serving if capacity exhausted.

liam (Legal): Contract-wise we need clear language on "dedicated" vs "logical reservation". Also specify incident handling and remediation windows for Premium SLA. I'll draft a clause. Example snippet: "Provider will maintain dedicated compute resources for Customer's Premium Isolation and will provide SLA credits if remediation exceeds 4 hours."

alex (PM): Good — launch criteria suggestion: 1) Engineering perf validation (latency P50/P95 within 10% of shared) 2) Pricing defined + packaging in Console 3) Legal clause + SOC artifact checklist 4) Beta customer signed (ACME or similar).

maya (Eng): Perf validation might fail for tight models. We should allow model-category exclusions (e.g., huge context models run on shared pool only). Also need autoscaling rules for Premium to avoid silent OOMs.

sam (Sales): ACME is willing to be beta if we can commit to audit logs + KMS. They want a term sheet this week.

liam (Legal): For beta, propose language: "Beta features are provided AS-IS; SLA applies after GA date." Keeps risk lower.

alex (PM): Pricing thinking: Basic = flat + small per-GPU-hour premium, Premium = higher flat + committed min monthly spend. We should surface estimated monthly bill in Console when enabling. Nora can own UI copy.

nora (Solutions): I'll draft the Console wording and a cost estimator widget. Need input on how we bill (hourly vs daily granularity).

maya (Eng): Implementation rough estimate: Basic = 2 sprints from infra (quota + scheduler affinity). Premium = 6–9 sprints (pool lifecycle, routing, telemetry, SLA automation). Prioritize Basic for faster ship.

alex (PM): Decision call: Roll forward Basic as an early add-on (beta) to meet ACME demo; scope Premium as Q2 initiative gated on capacity tests and legal signoff. Any objections?

sam (Sales): No objections. I'll tell ACME Basic-first, set expectation on Premium timeline.

liam (Legal): I'll prep beta and GA contract language, plus required compliance checklist for Premium.

maya (Eng): We'll scope tickets for Basic this week. Need product acceptance test: able to reserve a min of X GPUs and verify tenant isolation under load.

ops-bot: deploy:infra-pipeline started for feature-flag "compute-isolation-basic" — CI kicked off.

alex (PM): Action items: Maya -> engineering RFC + ticket breakdown by Friday; Nora -> Console copy + estimator prototype; Liam -> contract snippets; Sam -> confirm ACME pilot and schedule demo. We'll sync Thurs 10am. :thumbsup:

nora (Solutions): noted, will have a mock at Thurs sync.

sam (Sales): Pinged ACME — they want Thurs 2pm demo, ask if 10am works for us.

alex (PM): Keep 10am slot tentative. If ACME insists on 2pm we'll adjust. Thanks everyone. :rocket:
